def: a bone (as the skeleton of the body); hence, self, i.e. (figuratively) very

words.word: it under him on the top

occurrences.text: Issachar is a strong ass couching down between two burdens:
Then they hasted, and took every man his garment, and put it under him on the top of the stairs, and blew with trumpets, saying, Jehu is king.
words: it under him on the top

occurrences.text: His bones are as strong pieces of brass; his bones are like bars of iron.
